subject: FAR
title: Foreign Currency Denominated Receivables and Payables
scenario:
Meridian Instruments Inc. is a U.S. company that prepares its financial statements in U.S. dollars and reports on a calendar-year basis. During Year 1 the company entered into several sales and purchase transactions denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar. Some of these transactions were settled during Year 1 and others remained unsettled at December 31, Year 1.

The direct spot exchange rates on the relevant dates are presented in **Exhibit 1**. The transactions are described in **Exhibit 2**, and additional information taken from the Year 1 records is presented in **Exhibit 3**.

Meridian records each transaction using the spot rate on the transaction date, adjusts monetary balances denominated in another currency to the spot rate at each reporting date, and reports the resulting gains and losses in income. Round all amounts to the nearest whole dollar and ignore income taxes.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: Direct Spot Exchange Rates (U.S. dollars per unit of currency)
Exhibit 2: Transactions Denominated in Other Currencies
exhibits.content:
**Transaction A.** On November 15, Year 1, Meridian sold laboratory equipment to a customer in Germany for €500,000. Title and control passed to the customer on November 15, Year 1. The customer paid the full €500,000 on March 10, Year 2.

**Transaction B.** On December 1, Year 1, Meridian purchased component inventory from a supplier in the United Kingdom for £300,000 on account. The goods were received on December 1, Year 1 and none of them had been sold or used as of December 31, Year 1. Meridian paid the supplier in full on February 1, Year 2.

**Transaction C.** On October 20, Year 1, Meridian sold instruments to a customer in Japan for ¥60,000,000. The customer paid the full ¥60,000,000 on December 18, Year 1.

**Transaction D.** On December 5, Year 1, Meridian signed a noncancelable purchase order for €200,000 of components to be manufactured and delivered in April Year 2. Neither the goods nor an invoice had been received as of December 31, Year 1, and no payment had been made.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 3: Additional Information From the Year 1 Records
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Total sales revenue for Year 1 (all currencies, translated to U.S. dollars at the transaction date rates) | $18,400,000 |
| Accounts receivable denominated in U.S. dollars at December 31, Year 1 | $2,340,000 |
| Accounts payable denominated in U.S. dollars at December 31, Year 1 | $1,105,000 |

Meridian had no receivables or payables denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar at January 1, Year 1, and entered into no transactions denominated in another currency during Year 1 other than those described in Exhibit 2. Meridian did not enter into any contract to fix the exchange rate on any of these amounts.

tasks.title: Euro Receivable at Year End
tasks.instruction: Determine the carrying amount, in U.S. dollars, of the receivable from the German customer reported in the December 31, Year 1 statement of financial position. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: A receivable denominated in another currency is a monetary item and is adjusted to the year-end spot rate. €500,000 x $1.145 = $572,500.
tasks.explanationJa:
外貨建ての売掛金は**貨幣性項目**であり、決算日の直物レートで換算し直す。

1. 取引日（11月15日）: €500,000 × $1.180 = $590,000 で売上と売掛金を計上
2. 決算日（12月31日）: €500,000 × $1.145 = **$572,500**
3. B/S計上額は $572,500

差額 $17,500 は為替差損として Year 1 の損益に計上される。

tasks.title: Pound Payable at Year End
tasks.instruction: Determine the carrying amount, in U.S. dollars, of the payable to the United Kingdom supplier reported in the December 31, Year 1 statement of financial position. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: A payable denominated in another currency is a monetary item and is adjusted to the year-end spot rate. £300,000 x $1.360 = $408,000.
tasks.explanationJa:
外貨建ての買掛金も貨幣性項目であり、決算日レートで換算し直す。

1. 取引日（12月1日）: £300,000 × $1.320 = $396,000 で仕入と買掛金を計上
2. 決算日（12月31日）: £300,000 × $1.360 = **$408,000**
3. 負債が $12,000 増加するため、同額が為替差損となる。

tasks.title: December 31, Year 1 Adjusting Entry
tasks.instruction: Prepare the single compound December 31, Year 1 adjusting entry required for the balances denominated in other currencies. Enter whole dollars, no commas. Enter 0 in cells that should have no amount.
tasks.explanation: The euro receivable falls from $590,000 to $572,500, a $17,500 loss. The pound payable rises from $396,000 to $408,000, a $12,000 loss. The combined debit to the loss account is $29,500. The yen sale was settled on December 18, Year 1, so no year-end adjustment is required for it.
tasks.explanationJa:
決算日に残っている外貨建ての貨幣性項目だけを調整する。

1. ユーロ建て売掛金: 590,000 → 572,500 → 貸方 $17,500（資産の減少）
2. ポンド建て買掛金: 396,000 → 408,000 → 貸方 $12,000（負債の増加）
3. 借方 為替差損 = 17,500 + 12,000 = **$29,500**

円建ての売掛金は12月18日に決済済みのため、決算調整は不要である。借方合計と貸方合計はいずれも $29,500 で一致する。

tasks.title: Year 1 Net Transaction Gain or Loss
tasks.instruction: Determine the net foreign currency transaction gain or loss included in Year 1 income from all of the transactions described in Exhibit 2. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas, and enter a net loss as a negative number.
tasks.explanation: Transaction A produces a $17,500 loss ($590,000 to $572,500). Transaction B produces a $12,000 loss ($396,000 to $408,000). Transaction C was settled during Year 1: ¥60,000,000 recorded at $543,000 and collected for $532,800, a $10,200 loss. Transaction D required no entry. Net = -$39,700.

tasks.title: Year 2 Net Transaction Gain or Loss on Settlement
tasks.instruction: Determine the net foreign currency transaction gain or loss recognized in Year 2 when the euro receivable and the pound payable are settled. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas, and enter a net loss as a negative number.
tasks.explanation: The euro receivable carried at $572,500 is collected on March 10, Year 2 for €500,000 x $1.205 = $602,500, a $30,000 gain. The pound payable carried at $408,000 is settled on February 1, Year 2 for £300,000 x $1.290 = $387,000, a $21,000 gain. Net gain = $51,000.
tasks.explanationJa:
決済時の差額は、**決算日レートで換算した帳簿価額**と決済額の差として Year 2 に計上する。

1. ユーロ売掛金: 回収額 €500,000 × $1.205 = $602,500、期末帳簿価額 $572,500 → **+$30,000**
2. ポンド買掛金: 支払額 £300,000 × $1.290 = $387,000、期末帳簿価額 $408,000 → **+$21,000**（少ない支払で済んだため利益）
3. 純額 = 30,000 + 21,000 = **+$51,000**（純利益）

取引全体で見た損益は、Aが 602,500 - 590,000 = +12,500、Bが 396,000 - 387,000 = +9,000 となるが、GAAPでは期間ごとにレート変動を認識する。

tasks.title: Carrying Amount of the Purchased Inventory
tasks.instruction: Select the amount at which the component inventory purchased from the United Kingdom supplier is reported in the December 31, Year 1 statement of financial position, assuming its cost does not exceed its net realizable value.
tasks.explanation: Inventory is a nonmonetary asset. It is recorded using the spot rate on the date of the purchase, £300,000 x $1.320 = $396,000, and is not adjusted for later changes in the exchange rate even though the related payable is adjusted.
tasks.explanationJa:
棚卸資産は**非貨幣性資産**であり、取得日のレートで記録した金額のまま据え置く。

1. 取得日（12月1日）: £300,000 × $1.320 = **$396,000**
2. 決算日レート $1.360 で換算し直すのは**買掛金だけ**（貨幣性項目）
3. したがって棚卸資産の計上額は $396,000 のまま

買掛金は $408,000 に修正され、その差額 $12,000 が為替差損となる。棚卸資産と買掛金の金額が一致しなくなる点がこの論点の要である。

tasks.title: Research — Recognition of Transaction Gains and Losses
tasks.instruction: Which section of the FASB Accounting Standards Codification requires a foreign currency transaction gain or loss to be included in determining net income for the period in which the exchange rate changes? Cite the ASC reference in XXX-XX-XX-XX format.
tasks.explanation: ASC 830-20-35-1 provides that a change in exchange rates between the reporting currency and the currency in which a transaction is denominated produces a transaction gain or loss that is included in determining net income for the period in which the rate changes.
tasks.explanationJa: ASC 830-20-35-1は、外貨建取引について為替レートが変動した期間の**当期純利益**に為替差損益を含めることを定めている。決済まで損益を繰り延べるのではなく、決算日ごとに認識する点が重要である。

subject: FAR
title: Foreign Currency Denominated Receivable and Payable
scenario:
Harbor Instruments, Inc. is a U.S. company that maintains its accounting records and prepares its financial statements in U.S. dollars. Its fiscal year ends December 31.

During the fourth quarter of Year 1, Harbor entered into two transactions denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar. Both were still outstanding at December 31, Year 1 and were settled during Year 2. The transactions are described in **Exhibit 1**, and the relevant spot exchange rates are provided in **Exhibit 2**. Additional company information appears in **Exhibit 3**.

Use the exhibits to complete the tasks below. Harbor does not use any risk-management contracts, and no allowance for credit losses is required on the receivable.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 1: Foreign Currency Transactions
exhibits.content:
**Transaction 1 — Sale on account**

On November 1, Year 1, Harbor sold laboratory equipment to a customer located in the United Kingdom. The invoice is denominated in British pounds (GBP) in the amount of GBP 400,000 and is payable on February 1, Year 2. Harbor recorded the sale and the related account receivable on November 1, Year 1.

**Transaction 2 — Purchase on account**

On December 1, Year 1, Harbor purchased precision components from a supplier located in Switzerland. The invoice is denominated in Swiss francs (CHF) in the amount of CHF 250,000 and is payable on March 1, Year 2. Harbor recorded the purchase and the related account payable on December 1, Year 1.

Both invoices were paid in full on their respective due dates.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 2: Spot Exchange Rates (U.S. dollars per one unit of foreign currency)
exhibits.content:
| Date | GBP | CHF | EUR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| November 1, Year 1 | 1.2500 | 1.0800 | 1.0900 |
| December 1, Year 1 | 1.2700 | 1.1000 | 1.0750 |
| December 31, Year 1 | 1.3000 | 1.0600 | 1.1000 |
| February 1, Year 2 | 1.2850 | 1.0450 | 1.1100 |
| March 1, Year 2 | 1.2600 | 1.0500 | 1.1200 |

Rates shown are the spot rates quoted by Harbor's principal bank at the close of business on each date.

exhibits.title: Exhibit 3: Additional Information
exhibits.content:
1. Harbor's accounts receivable balance denominated in U.S. dollars was $2,140,000 at December 31, Year 1.
2. Harbor maintains a EUR-denominated bank account for travel expenses; the account balance was immaterial at all dates presented.
3. Harbor's effective income tax rate is 21%. All amounts requested in the tasks below are pre-tax amounts.
4. Harbor's fiscal year ends December 31. The Year 1 financial statements were issued on March 15, Year 2.

tasks.title: Receivable at the balance sheet date
tasks.instruction: Determine the U.S. dollar carrying amount of the GBP-denominated account receivable reported on Harbor's December 31, Year 1 balance sheet. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: Receivables denominated in a currency other than the U.S. dollar are remeasured at the current spot rate at each balance sheet date. GBP 400,000 x 1.3000 = $520,000.
tasks.explanationJa:
外貨建の債権は各決算日の直物レートで換算し直す。

1. 取引日（Nov 1, Year 1）の計上額: GBP 400,000 × 1.2500 = $500,000
2. 決算日（Dec 31, Year 1）の換算額: GBP 400,000 × 1.3000 = **$520,000**

したがって貸借対照表計上額は $520,000。差額 $20,000 は為替差益として当期損益に計上される。

tasks.title: Payable at the balance sheet date
tasks.instruction: Determine the U.S. dollar carrying amount of the CHF-denominated account payable reported on Harbor's December 31, Year 1 balance sheet. Enter the amount in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanation: The payable is remeasured at the December 31, Year 1 spot rate: CHF 250,000 x 1.0600 = $265,000. It was initially recorded on December 1, Year 1 at CHF 250,000 x 1.1000 = $275,000.
tasks.explanationJa:
外貨建の債務も決算日レートで換算し直す。

1. 取引日（Dec 1, Year 1）の計上額: CHF 250,000 × 1.1000 = $275,000
2. 決算日（Dec 31, Year 1）の換算額: CHF 250,000 × 1.0600 = **$265,000**

負債が $10,000 減少しているため、$10,000 の為替差益が Year 1 の損益に計上される。取引日レートは Dec 1 のもの（1.1000）を使う点に注意。

tasks.title: Year 1 net transaction gain or loss
tasks.instruction: Determine the net foreign currency transaction gain or loss recognized in Harbor's Year 1 income statement from the two transactions. Enter a net gain as a positive number and a net loss as a negative number, in whole dollars, no commas.
tasks.explanationJa:
決算日換算による差額を合計する。

| 項目 | 取引日 | 決算日 | 差額 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 売掛金（GBP） | $500,000 | $520,000 | +$20,000（利益） |
| 買掛金（CHF） | $275,000 | $265,000 | +$10,000（利益） |

資産は増加が利益、負債は減少が利益。合計 = **+$30,000（純為替差益）**。

これらは決済前でも当期の損益に計上する（実現主義ではない）点が重要。

tasks.title: Journal entry to record settlement of the receivable
tasks.instruction: Prepare the journal entry Harbor records on February 1, Year 2 to record collection of the GBP-denominated receivable. Enter all amounts in whole dollars, no commas. Enter 0 in cells that should have no amount.
tasks.explanation: Cash received = GBP 400,000 x 1.2850 = $514,000. The receivable was carried at $520,000 after the December 31, Year 1 remeasurement, so a $6,000 transaction loss is recognized in Year 2.
tasks.explanationJa:
決済日のレートで受取現金額を計算し、決算日換算後の帳簿価額との差額を為替差損益とする。

1. 受取現金: GBP 400,000 × 1.2850 = $514,000
2. 売掛金の帳簿価額（Dec 31, Year 1 換算後）: $520,000
3. 差額: $520,000 − $514,000 = $6,000 の為替差損

仕訳:

| 科目 | 借方 | 貸方 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cash | 514,000 | — |
| Foreign currency transaction loss | 6,000 | — |
| Accounts receivable (GBP) | — | 520,000 |

借方合計・貸方合計とも $520,000 で一致する。

tasks.title: Income statement classification
tasks.instruction: Select how foreign currency transaction gains and losses on these two transactions are reported in Harbor's financial statements.
options: Included in income from continuing operations in the period in which the exchange rate changes
Reported in other comprehensive income until the related receivable or payable is settled
Deferred and recognized in income only at the settlement date
tasks.correctAnswer: Included in income from continuing operations in the period in which the exchange rate changes
tasks.explanation: A change in exchange rates on a receivable or payable denominated in a foreign currency produces a transaction gain or loss that is included in determining net income for the period in which the rate changes.
tasks.explanationJa:
外貨建の債権債務に係る為替差損益は、レートが変動した期の当期純利益に含めて計上する。

- 決済を待って認識するのではなく、決算日ごとに換算差額を損益計上する
- その他の包括利益（OCI）ではなく、継続事業からの利益に含める

したがって正解は「レートが変動した期の継続事業利益に含める」。

tasks.title: Year 2 net transaction gain or loss
tasks.instruction: Determine the net foreign currency transaction gain or loss recognized in Harbor's Year 2 income statement from settlement of the two transactions. Enter a net gain as a positive number and a net loss as a negative number, in whole dollars, no commas.

tasks.title: Research
tasks.instruction: Identify the authoritative guidance stating that a foreign currency transaction gain or loss resulting from a change in exchange rates shall be included in determining net income for the period in which the exchange rate changes. Cite the ASC reference in XXX-XX-XX-XX format.
tasks.explanation: ASC 830-20-35-2 requires a foreign currency transaction gain or loss to be included in determining net income for the period in which the exchange rate changes.
tasks.explanationJa:
ASC 830-20-35-2 は、外貨建取引に係る為替差損益を、為替レートが変動した期の当期純利益の算定に含めることを要求している。

- ASC 830-20-35-1: 各決算日に外貨建残高を当日の直物レートで換算し直す
- ASC 830-20-35-2: その換算差額を当期純利益に含める

本設問が問う「損益計上のタイミング」を定めているのは 830-20-35-2。
